author: sjm41
body:
* **PTHR ID & PTN node:**
PTN000882372 (PTHR11247)

* **Sequences with problematic annotation (ID + gene/protein name):**
Fly Ppt1 (Palmitoyl-protein thioesterase 1) (FBgn0030057) and orthologs

* **Type of Issue: Erroneous source or erroneous propagation, or other issue**
Erroneous source


This node is currently annotated with these two MFs:
palmitoyl-(protein) hydrolase activity
long-chain fatty acyl-CoA hydrolase activity

But it should only have 'palmitoyl-(protein) hydrolase activity'

I've just removed the erroneous source annotations to (BOVIN|Gene=PPT1|UniProtKB=P45478) and (HUMAN|HGNC=9325|UniProtKB=P50897), so just need to edit the PAINT annotations.
title: PTN000882372 (PTHR11247)

author: marcfeuermann
body:
I've removed long-chain fatty acyl-CoA hydrolase activity. 
I've also removed palmytoyl (protein) hydrolase activity from PPT2 node as requested by Nadine Gruaz from Swiss-Prot since 
PPT2 hydrolyzes unbranched structures such as palmitoyl-CoA but not palmitoylcysteine or palmitoylated proteins.   (PubMed=1285569). This might be interesting for you too.
Thanks for all the suggestions. This improves a lot the annotation.
